description: Update an existing HTTP forward for a domain. Returns the stored forward. frame is reset to false unless given. The host itself cannot be changed: to move a forward, delete it and create it again for the new host.

domain_id.description: the Domeneshop domain ID, from list_domains

frame.description: if true, show the destination in a frame instead of redirecting; defaults to false

host.description: the host/subdomain to forward, e.g. 'www' or '@' for the root

url.description: the destination URL to forward requests to, starting with http:// or https://

name: update_forward
title: Update HTTP forward
